<@126385519469789184> https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-zkevm%40v21.0.1
I think the description is quite useful to skim, in particular last pharagraph.

Now tests filling works correctly for many of tests that mutate the execution payload rlp bytes and might produce a mismatch with block_hash (e.g. mutating the BAL rlp bytes and checking guest program catches that).

Now should also has more coverage of other tests that used `rlp_modifier` for example to arbitrarly mutate `gas_used` and double check the guest program does those checks etc. This didn't work quite well until now, so should be fixed.

Mostly mentioning this if you get some failures, could be related to all this (apart from removing `pub_keys` input).

(Can't make "alpha" releases since looks like EEST has a strict naming format -- in any case if something is broken in this v20.0.1 one, I'll not officially announce until have some feedback 😅 )
